name: Frontline Ranger (Combat)
body:
Bows are more versatile in your hands than most.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Weapon Focus (any bow)

Benefit(s): You may wield a long bow as a quarterstaff or a shortbow as a club, doing so requires no action and you threaten adjacent squares while wielding these weapons. You may make both melee and ranged attack rolls in the same round with these weapons. Whenever you make a melee attack with a bow in this way and deal damage to your target you may make a free trip attempt against them without provoking an attack of opportunity.
